notes: Distance sums within each track segment only; gaps between segments are not bridged.
Input must be WGS84; GPX cannot reliably declare GCJ-02.
Sparse-point distances underestimate curves; long edges require review.
Raw elevation sums are noise-sensitive and partial if elevations are missing. No road legality or surface suitability inference.

gpx_xsd_validation: not performed; XML/gpxpy structural roundtrip only
synthetic_file: temporary directory, deleted; never a real route
